items.task: This package belongs to the full reproduction of two papers that the user asked for on 2026-11-22 (coord/DECISIONS/0028): arXiv:2512.14649, 'Stochastic Inflation in Numerical Relativity' (source /data/haiyangw/nrpic/kb-data/raw/arxiv/2512.14649/v2/src/PRD_v2.tex, 791 lines) and arXiv:2401.08530, 'Stochastic Inflation in General Relativity' (source /data/haiyangw/nrpic/kb-data/raw/arxiv/2401.08530/v2/src/Stochastic_Inflation.tex, 1079 lines); the companion on initial conditions, arXiv:2502.06783, is in the store too (kb-data/raw/arxiv/2502.06783/). The sources are read-only and never copied into git; their figures are never committed, and nothing read off a figure is committed as a data file (single comparison values with their locator may stand in text). The authors' code is not public and their random realisations are their own: agreement is statistical, against the linear solution, and against the numbers the papers print. This track has already reproduced both scenarios of the first paper against the linear solution (ladder/, usr/, g2prod/, window/, a4res/, spec/scope/SCOPE.md, note/): build on that and do not redo it. A lead session of this owner may be working in the worktree beside you: commit path-limited, only your package directory and your run manifests.
